product.description: Blackbird™ PRO by Monoprice™H.265 HDMI® over IP KitDistribute Full HD video to distances up to 492 feet (150 meters) over your existing Gigabit Ethernet networkThe Blackbird™ PRO H.265 HDMI® over IP Kit allows you to distribute an HDMI video signal to distances up to 492 feet (150 meters) over a single Cat5e/6 Ethernet cable. In addition to a normal connection between the Encoder/Transmitter and Decoder/Receiver, the Encoder can be connected directly to a computer and the signal can be decoded using the VLC® free, open‑source media player. It can also connect to one or more Decoders/Receivers through an Ethernet switch, thereby allowing distribution to multiple displays. it supports the H.264 and H.265 codecs and video resolutions up to 1900x1200@60Hz with the YCbCr 4:4:4 color space.Transmits to distances up to 492 feet (150 meters) using a single Cat5e/6 Ethernet cableDistribute HD video over IP networks using Gigabit Ethernet switchesTransmit directly to a computer and decode using the VLC™ free, open-source media playerComplies with the HDMI™ 1.4b and HDCP™ 1.4 specificationsSupports up to 10.2 Gbps bandwidthSupports video resolutions up to 1900x1200@60Hz with the YCbCr 4:4:4 color spaceSupports the H.264 and H.265 video compression codecsSupports broadband IR extension NETWORK BROADCASTThe system is designed to work with your existing Gigabit Ethernet network, allowing you to extend the HDMI® signal to any part of your home. Simply add a decoder at the remote location to view the source video. This gives a virtually unlimited number of extensions. SUPPORTS FULL HDIn addition to support for Full HD (1080p) video, this extendersupports video resolutions up to 1900x1200@60Hz with the YCbCr 4:4:4 color space. VIDEO COMPRESSIONWhen transmitted over a network, Full HD uncompressed video canbog down the network.
